subject.title: Feature Request: Image batching / media group buffering at gateway layer

question: Should OpenClaw add opt-in LINE same-sender media batching, design a shared media-batching contract first, or keep heuristic batching unsupported for channels without native grouping metadata?
rationale: LINE currently has no OpenClaw grouping key or config surface for this behavior, and automation should not choose the public config name, default latency, flush-on-text semantics, reply-token tradeoff, or plugin-versus-core ownership.

options.title: Add LINE opt-in batching
options.body: Add a conservative LINE plugin setting that batches only same-account, same-conversation, same-sender downloadable media with documented latency and reply-token behavior.

options.title: Design shared contract first
options.body: Define a media-aware channel SDK/core batching contract before changing LINE, accepting broader architecture and compatibility review.

options.title: Keep heuristics unsupported
options.body: Keep native Telegram album buffering only and document that channels without grouping metadata dispatch media events individually.

recommendation.title: Add LINE opt-in batching
recommendation.body: Add a conservative LINE plugin setting that batches only same-account, same-conversation, same-sender downloadable media with documented latency and reply-token behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The current LINE handler/config history makes this the best available owner for the LINE plugin product-boundary decision.
